messages:
maya_cs: Quick heads-up — Nimbus renewal conversation. Customer wants to shorten from 12mo -> 9mo and will pay by PO. Need guidance on pricing/pro-rate and sign path.

sam_ae: @maya_cs thanks — do they want the same seat count? any change to committed MRR?

maya_cs: Same seats for now. Finance flagged net30 + PO, procurement is pushing a 9mo term. They asked if we can offer any pro‑rated discount for the shorter term.

lex_legal: Heads up — shortening term means we need an amendment and to validate early-termination language. Ping me the draft and I'll quick-review.

ariane_procurement: Can they sign via DocuSign? Also need vendor code and PO template. Their procurement team requires KMS language in contract.

sam_ae: Client prefers eSign. @maya_cs is BYOK/KMS mandatory or negotiable? If required, we need security input.

maya_cs: Confirmed: procurement says BYOK is a blocker unless we include the clause. Options I see: 1) keep pricing (no discount) and pro-rate for 9mo, 2) offer a small concession (1–10%). Thoughts?

simon_revops: From revops: if we shorten to 9mo, revenue recognition wants invoice schedule clarified. Also recommend 95% list for 9mo to avoid setting precedent.

maya_cs: Draft amendment snippet I put in workspace:
```text
Amendment: Term changed to 9 months. Pricing: pro rata based on agreed annual list. Invoice schedule: 50% upfront, 50% at day 90. DocuSign-enabled signature. BYOK clause to be appended if security greenlights.
```

ariane_procurement: PO template received from customer: https://files.example.com/nimbus_po_template.pdf — they will attach vendor code once legal confirms amendment.

lex_legal: I'll do an EOD pass. Need to confirm the BYOK wording and liability bits. If BYOK is required, include reference to KMS integration SLA and onboarding timeline.

eng-security-bot: Security note: BYOK requires onboarding ticket and key material handling review. Created ticket SEC-4821 for integration and runbook. ETA for review: 3 business days.

maya_cs: Thanks @lex_legal and @eng-security-bot. Next steps: legal to finalize amendment, revops to confirm invoice schedule language, procurement to secure vendor code + PO. I'll schedule a 15m sync with the customer tomorrow 9:30am PST to confirm approach.

sam_ae: I can join the call.

ariane_procurement: Once amendment is approved, I'll queue the PO and send DocuSign. Will also chase vendor code.

maya_cs: Perfect — I'll post the final draft in this thread once legal returns. Will also attach the customer's PO once available.

lex_legal: Reviewing now, will share redlines in thread.

maya_cs: Thanks everyone — aiming to close amendment + PO within 48hrs to avoid service gap. :thumbsup:
